description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git's atomic push feature. The script sets up repositories, performs push operations with various options, checks the results, and verifies correctness of atomic push handling including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories named upstream and workbench, configures the upstream to warn on current branch updates, and adds upstream as a remote in workbench.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares specific references between upstream and workbench repositories to verify their states.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of push status reports to highlight the status lines.
